description: Experiment A: conservative whole-frame fine-tuning of the existing Yakimov nail-bed Hb EfficientNet-B0 (no nail cropping).
loss: SmoothL1Loss on train-normalised Hb (same as original training)

augmentation.applied_to: training images only, after the production preprocessing
augmentation.colour_changes: none (nail-bed colour is the Hb evidence)

preprocessing: Identical to production: EXIF transpose -> RGBA composited on white -> RGB -> ImageOps.pad to 224x224 (bilinear, white) -> ToTensor -> ImageNet normalisation
